content: I think everyone should look at all videos out there. From different angles it tells a different version. We need to wait for the investigation to prove what angle this officer was at. But an officer telling you to get out with your hands up does not mean, take off in your car.
I see the protesters have learned a valuable lesson and there are no protesters using their vehicle as a deadly weapon. You just have to look harder to see the good in all things, lesson learned.

An interesting thing to think about, is how our stances vary in very similar curcumstances. For example, this protesting and the protesting on Jan 6th. Both ended up with Law enforcement shooting and killing someone. But our responses, depending on our political view, often switch stances in similar instances.
Wondering if these folks asked off from work?
Bc when I protest I wear a gas mask....

My question is whether this active law enforcement operation was occurring in this lady’s neighborhood, or if she had driven from somewhere else to specifically and purposely interfere in the operation.
The best way to disperse the crowd is to say something like “The walleyes on Mille Lacs are really biting”
You have the ‘Fog of war’ scenario and this case might be best categorised as the ‘Fog of Law’
A water cannon would not be needed, merely blow a mist like a snow maker. The cold weather would take care of the situation.
"After a women tried hitting the agent" fixed it.
